name: @streamarr-tv/admin
description: Streamarr's own admin web UI: Vite + React + TypeScript. Source-instance registration and user management -- the operator-facing control plane for the Streamarr server itself, co-hosted by streamarr-bin at its own origin. Distinct from Playarr Web (clients/tv-web/web), which is the consumer streaming client that connects to Streamarr.
